title: ee.global_promotion.report.v1
description: Execution report for ee memory promote-global: the policy plan plus what actually happened (dry-run plans set executed=false; an exact-content global twin reports alreadyPromoted=true and merges instead of inserting a sibling).

globalMemoryId.description: The global row this promotion created or matched; null when refused or dry-run.

alreadyPromoted.description: True when an exact-content global twin already existed (idempotent re-promotion).
